title: 12月31日
problem_statement_md:
你正在处理[ca-covid.csv](/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv)文件，包含2020年加州的新冠感染数据。
该文件提供了全年的每日病例数和死亡数据。

找到并输出对应于2020年12月31日的那一行。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]December 31[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working with the '[b]ca-covid[/b]' CSV file that contains the COVID-19 infection data in California for the year 2020.
The file provides data on daily cases and deaths for the entire year. 
Find and output the row that corresponds to [b]December 31, 2020[/b]. 
[note]The requested date is the last row in the dataset, so you can use indexing to select it.[/note]
hint_md: 要求的日期是数据集中的最后一行，所以你可以使用索引来获取。

code_templates.solution_code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("/content/assets/9e2529a85d9a7bf0bd91.csv")
df.set_index('date', inplace=True)
df.drop('state', axis=1, inplace=True)


print(df.iloc[-1])
